summary: Selects and installs a texture codec dispatch pair on a context object. With flag a2 set it installs TrackSurfaceHeightmapIncrement + VehicleUpdateFrameSetup and marks the context dirty. With a2 clear it installs a no-op second slot and selects BlockTextureDecompression when the mode at this+0x4C equals 2, otherwise PackedPixelCopyWithPaletteLookup, applying row-count underflow/overflow resets through the object vtable. In mode 2 it allocates and zeroes a dither buffer and initializes a symmetric array. A dirty flag on the context triggers zeroing of 32 rows of 0x1000 bytes.

operations.description: Test whether the codec mode at this+0x4C equals 0.
Load the context pointer v4 from this+0x1A4.
Save result = *(v4+24) as the row-table base v9 used by the dirty-row clear.
When the mode at this+0x4C was nonzero, promote it to 2.
Flag-set branch: install TrackSurfaceHeightmapIncrement at context+4 (this+0x1A8), VehicleUpdateFrameSetup at context+8 (this+0x1AC), and set the dirty flag context+0x1C (this+0x1C0) to 1.
Flag-clear branch: when mode this+0x4C equals 2 select BlockTextureDecompression, otherwise PackedPixelCopyWithPaletteLookup, as the first dispatch slot; install nullsub_4 at context+8.
Row count this+0x70 below 1 triggers the underflow reset: write a small bound to obj+0x14 and 1 to obj+0x18, then invoke the object vtable.
Indirect call through the obj+0x0 vtable to run the underflow reset.
Row count this+0x70 above 256 triggers the overflow clamp: write 56 to obj+0x14 and 256 to obj+0x18, then invoke the vtable and use its result.
Indirect call through the this+0x0 vtable returning the clamped reset result.
Default result of 256 when the row count falls inside the valid range.
Compute the mode-2 allocation size v7 = 6 * (this+0x5C + 2).
Allocate the context+0x20 buffer (this+0x1C4) through the allocator at this+0x4+4 when it is unset.
MemoryZeroFill the allocated context+0x20 buffer for v7 bytes.
Call SymmetricArrayInit(a1) when the context+0x28 slot (this+0x1CC) is unset.
Clear the context+0x24 toggle field (this+0x1C8) to 0.
When the dirty flag context+0x1C (this+0x1C0) is set, zero 32 rows of 0x1000 bytes each from the row-table base v9, then clear the flag to 0.
MemoryZeroFill each of the 32 row pointers at v9 + 4*i.
Return result, which is the last operation result or the default 256.
ABI: __cdecl(_DWORD* a1, char a2) returning int; a1 is the object, a2 is the dispatch flag.

for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) result = MemoryZeroFill(*(void**)(rows + 4*i), 0x1000);
